plan.title: Surprise one-day salmon event
plan.question: Does a surprise one-day event (salmon PERFECTs pay +2) lift play that day? Compared with the same weekday a week earlier.
plan.decide: Worth repeating monthly if runs per player that day rise 10%+. Rotate the ingredient.
